reason: Memory exhaustion when a large array is validated against an array schema without a length limit. No patched 3.x release exists; the fix is zod 4.6.6+. The zod 4 migration touches 91 files using .uuid(), 66 test files whose synthetic UUIDs zod 4 rejects, and the OpenAPI exporter (zod-to-json-schema has no zod 4 support), so it is scheduled as its own change.
mitigation: packages/api/src/middleware/json-array-cap.ts refuses any JSON body carrying more than 250,000 array elements (413 BODY_TOO_MANY_ELEMENTS) before any schema runs, bounding zod's issue accumulation; express.json() already caps bodies at 10 MB. Largest array any schema accepts is 10,000 elements.
